identity.title: The ALPINE-ALMA [C II] survey. Little to no evolution in the [C II]-SFR relation over the last 13 Gyr

paper_type_evidence.quote: we used the ALMA Large Program to INvestigate $C^+$ at Early Times (ALPINE) survey, which targets 118 ‘normal’ (i.e. main sequence) star-forming galaxies with known spectroscopic redshifts at $4.4 < z< 5.9$

evidence.quote: has observed 118 ‘normal’ star-forming galaxies with known spectroscopic redshifts at $4.4 < z< 5.9$.

question.value: Does the [C II] 158 micron luminosity trace SFR at z>4 as in local galaxies, i.e. is there evolution in the L([CII])-SFR relation?

evidence.quote: it is unclear if the \[C ii\] 158 $\mu$m line remains a good tracer of star formation at $z> 4$ or if there is a quantitative change compared to the observations at low redshift.
This paper is based on data obtained with the ALMA Observatory, under Large Program 2017.1.00428.L.
we used the \[C ii\] 158 $\mu$m line luminosities ($L({\rm [CII]} )$, 75 detections with high significance, and 43 non-detections)

analysis_steps.goal: Assemble [C II], L_IR and SFR for ALPINE

method.value: Use published ALPINE [C II] luminosities and continuum; convert 158um continuum to L_IR with an empirical template; compute SFR(UV), SFR(IR), SFR(tot), with 3 sigma upper limits rescaled to FWHM=150 km/s

evidence.quote: we adopted FWHM $= 150$ km s$^{-1}$, instead of the median of $252$ km s$^{-1}$ of the \[C ii\]-detected ALPINE galaxies

assumptions.value: Template similar to modified blackbody T_d=42 K, beta=1.5

evidence.quote: a dust temperature of $T_d = 42$ K, a dust opacity at 850 $\mu$m of $k_{850} = 0.077 ~ {\rm m^2 ~kg^{-1}}$, and a grey-body power-law exponent $\beta = 1.5$

method.value: Apply mean IRX-beta relation to continuum-undetected sources; compare also SED-based SFRs and stacks

evidence.quote: We applied their mean IRX–$\beta$ relations to each individual source for which the dust continuum had not been detected

validation.value: Compared with SED-based and stacking corrections

findings_qualitative.value: No strong evidence for a [C II] deficit at z~4-8 once hidden SF is accounted for; no strong dependence on Lyα EW

evidence.quote: the currently available data show no strong evidence for a deficit of \[C ii\] from $z \sim 4$ to 8

limitations_admitted.value: Slope depends on assumptions for [C II] upper limits and on the dust-obscured SFR, which depends on the IR template and dust temperature

evidence.quote: the exact slope of the relation depends in part on the \[C ii\]-undetected sources, and hence on the detailed assumptions on the upper limits
